authorityRules: Implements the signed SITE_FILE input of AF-25/DEC-C03-013 and REQ-SR01-B0-REQ-OPS-004. It is separate from a configuration-generation commit, qualification receipt, service-effectiveness observation and notification STARTED receipt.

SiteDigest is SHA-256 of RFC8785 JSON of the complete parsed closed-schema site document, including its declared generation contentDigest. This authenticates an input; declaredContentDigest remains an unaccepted declaration until the effective-projection owner independently computes and binds it.

Privileged initial installation independently pins the P-256 issuer key/epoch, environment, exact named profile and authenticated schema/profile byte digests. Consumer verification rejects expired, premature, revoked/replaced or foreign issuer input, mismatched generation/base and any document mutation. Initial pins are not accepted from the signed document or an HTTP caller.

No secret bytes are permitted in the site document. Only immutable secret references may occur in SecretRef fields. Strict duplicate-key, Unicode NFC, closed schema, precedence and cross-field validation remain required in the existing installation owner.

A valid site signature grants no current setting, SQL write, service readiness, qualification, secret resolution, workload authentication, notification attempt or gateway send authority. The durable owner must admit the complete generation, observe every mandatory owner at that exact generation and fence supersession/revocation before a consumer can use any setting.

The issuer epoch and validity are signature-input eligibility, not whole-generation readiness. Preserve original signature/document bytes and failures; do not replace an old signature to repair a consumed intent. Missing complete accepted generation leaves startup and dependent effects unready.
